name: Requests
description: Allows users to submit media requests.
overview: A Jellyfin plugin for requesting movies and TV shows.

versions.changelog: Search results for the same title now merge across providers (linked through your library's IDs, or same title and year); custom statuses get a proper icon and all badge icons render reliably; subtle animations with an on/off switch under General > Appearance; faster page loads and less background work; "colour" is now "color".
